newsitem.title: USA: U.S. chain store sales off 0.3 pct - BTM/Schroders.
newsitem.headline: U.S. chain store sales off 0.3 pct - BTM/Schroders.

text.p: U.S. chain store sales fell 0.3 percent in the week ended January 11 from the prior week, according to the seasonally adjusted BTM/Schroders weekly chain store sales index.
Sales for the week were up 6.1 percent on a year-over-year basis, while the month-to-date index was up 0.1 percent from the prior month.
"Sales were generally on-to-below plan for most retailers," said the report. "Adverse weather in the Midwest restrained sales during the week but was not considered a major problem," it said.
